Confirmed via both grep and refdex: in `guava/src` (non-android main code), the only direct callers of `Segment.put(K, int, V, boolean)` are `LocalCache.put` (line 4202) and `LocalCache.putIfAbsent` (line 4210). No other main-code methods call it directly (tests excluded per your scope).

ANSWER: LocalCache.put, LocalCache.putIfAbsent
